Description.value: Plays your own sound clips: blood moon horde (and/or a warning earlier that day), when you enter the world, and morning and night bells at this world's dawn and dusk. Drop bloodmoon / spawn / morning / night as .ogg, .wav, or .mp3 into this folder. Players: the server does not need it. Server (optional): posts blood moon updates to Discord (see discord.example.txt); players do not need it for that.
